title: Electrical Station
physical_identity: Old electrical facility of brick-walled hallways, dusty concrete floors and dim fluorescent lights, with wiring, machinery and black-liquid pipes on the walls; contains special rooms and a large M.E.G. base.
scale_topology: Indoor maze of inconsistently sized halls; size unknown because indestructible bars block most of it; largest area several miles wide with a ceiling hundreds of feet tall.
anomalies: recent unexplained artwork and notebook pages
lighting_sound: Dim fluorescent lights; faint Level 0 hum plus whirring, buzzing, crackling electricity and liquid rushing in pipes; temperature 18-33 C.

entities.name: Hounds
entities.behavior: Camouflage and ambush; coordinate pursuit by bark pace

entities.name: Facelings
entities.behavior: All hostile, armed, martial arts, all evolved

entities.name: Deathmoths (incl. Praetorian)
entities.behavior: Aggressive swarms, immune to repellent, target mouth

entities.name: Empress Deathmoths and hive
entities.behavior: Wanderer claim of 3 coequal empresses; never found

entities.name: Skin-Stealers
entities.behavior: Disguise as humans, speak, translucent blood tell

entities.name: Smilers
entities.behavior: Elusive, ignore decoy lights, flashing light works

entities.name: Clumps
entities.behavior: Up to 8 ft, use weapons, bloodthirsty

entities.name: Death Rats
entities.behavior: Capybara-sized, set electrical traps, lead brigades

entities.name: Entity 71 (The Red Knight)
entities.behavior: Single 2017 panicked run through Base Gamma

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: Hounds, Facelings, Wretches, Deathmoths, Skin-Stealers, Smilers, Clumps, Death Rats (organised brigades); Entity 71 one-off; Empresses and shadow figure only as reports
hazards: black sludge burns and brain damage

entrances.quote: Numerous doors on Level 2 lead to Level 3.

entrances.conditions: Must not be an Entity 81 instance
entrances.quote: Any elevator that is not an instance of Entity 81 on Level 4 or Level 5 will bring wanderers to Level 3.

entrances.conditions: Must not be an Entity 81 instance; one elevator is inside Base Gamma
entrances.quote: Any elevator that is not an instance of Entity 81 on Level 4 or Level 5 will bring wanderers to Level 3.

entrances.method: Buildings with a brick interior; one leads into Base Gamma
entrances.quote: Buildings on Level 11 with a brick interior will lead to Level 3.

exits.quote: Elevators that are not instances of Entity 81 will lead to either Level 4 or Level 5 at random.
Elevators that are not instances of Entity 81 will lead to either Level 4 or Level 5 at random.

exits.method: Door in Base Gamma to the Level 11 entry point
exits.quote: There is a door in Base Gamma that will lead one right back to the Base Gamma entry point on Level 11

exits.method: Enter car in an occasionally appearing room
exits.quote: Occasionally, a room with a car inside may appear.

signature_mechanic: Bar-gated brick electrical maze with an entity-free Sanctum refuge and a fortress base; hostile entities act as coordinated brigades; paranoia hotspots in dark narrow halls.
verticality: Base Gamma has stacked sectors (Public, Residence above, Administration) and tunnels below; the rest is largely single-storey.
conflicts_notes: No survival class line captured. Roster title matches. Notebook pages are unreliable in-universe documents; Empress hive is wanderer claim.
